chatbots.empty: No chatbots yet. Create one to auto-answer new conversations.
chatbots.promptPlaceholder: You are a helpful support assistant for…
chatbots.activeNote: Only one chatbot can be active — activating this one pauses the others.

widgetSettings.title: Widget setup
widgetSettings.siteKeyHelp: Public identifier for your widget — safe to embed in any page.
widgetSettings.embedHelp: Paste before the closing body tag on any website (WordPress, Shopify, plain HTML…).
widgetSettings.identityConfigured: Signing is configured. Your backend signs each logged-in user's ID so mkEngage can trust who they are.
widgetSettings.identityNotConfigured: Signing is not configured yet. Rotate to generate your first secret.
widgetSettings.identityHelp: Compute the signature server-side and pass it to the widget — never expose the secret in the browser:
widgetSettings.rotateConfirm: Rotating invalidates all existing signatures immediately. Your backend must switch to the new secret. Continue?
widgetSettings.newSecretTitle: New signing secret — shown only once
widgetSettings.newSecretHelp: Store it in your backend's secret manager now. You will not be able to see it again.
widgetSettings.prechatEnable: Ask visitors for their name before the chat starts
widgetSettings.hoursEnable: Show an away notice outside business hours
widgetSettings.hoursHelp: Time ranges per day, e.g. 09:00-17:00. Separate multiple ranges with commas; leave empty for closed.
widgetSettings.triggersHelp: Automatically open the chat with a message when a rule matches. Each trigger fires once per visitor.
widgetSettings.triggerMessagePlaceholder: Hi! Can I help you with anything?
widgetSettings.appearanceHelp: Pick a design for your website's chat widget, then customize the color and logo. Changes apply the next time the widget loads.
widgetSettings.brandingHidden: White-label plan: "Powered by mkEngage" is hidden on your widget.
widgetSettings.brandingShown: Free plan shows "Powered by mkEngage" on the widget. Upgrade to white-label to remove it.
widgetSettings.logoUploaded: Uploaded! Widgets pick it up on next load.
widgetSettings.logoUploadError: Upload failed — PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF up to 1 MB.

departments.title: Departments
departments.empty: No departments yet. The first one becomes the default for new conversations.
departments.defaultNote: New widget conversations are routed to the default department.

knowledge.empty: No documents yet. Add your policies and FAQs so the bot can answer from them.
knowledge.bodyPlaceholder: Paste your policy, FAQ or article text…
knowledge.deleteConfirm: Delete this document? The chatbot will stop using it.

visitors.title: Live visitors
visitors.subtitle: People on your site right now. Start a conversation before they leave.
visitors.empty: No visitors on your site right now. This board refreshes every few seconds.

flowBuilder.title: Flow builder
flowBuilder.inspectorEmpty: Select a step on the canvas to edit it.
flowBuilder.saveError: Could not save — every message/options/question step needs text, and options edges need labels.
flowBuilder.hint: Drag from a step's bottom handle to the next step's top handle to connect them. Edges from an Options menu are labeled with the option they answer.
flowBuilder.templatesHint: Or add steps from the left palette to build from scratch.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Connect messaging channels so customers can reach you beyond the website widget. Replies from agents and your chatbot flow back automatically.
channels.connectHelp: From your Meta App (WhatsApp → API Setup): copy the Phone Number ID, a permanent access token, and the App Secret. After connecting, paste the webhook URL and verify token below into the Meta console.
channels.createError: Could not connect the channel — check the fields.
channels.metaSetupHint: Paste these into Meta App → WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook (subscribe to the messages field):
channels.telegramHelp: Create a bot with @BotFather on Telegram and paste its token here. mkEngage registers the webhook automatically when your server is publicly reachable.
channels.telegramSetupHint: Webhook registration is automatic on public hosts. If yours failed (local/dev), re-connect after deploying, or call setWebhook with this URL and secret token:
channels.messengerHelp: From your Meta App (Messenger → Settings): generate a Page access token and copy the App Secret. After connecting, paste the webhook URL and verify token into Meta's webhook configuration (subscribe to messages).
channels.messengerSetupHint: Paste these into Meta App → Messenger → Settings → Webhooks (subscribe to the messages field):

developers.title: Developers
developers.subtitle: Machine API keys for integrations and signed webhooks that push conversation events to your systems.
developers.keysHelp: Keys authenticate the read-only machine API (GET /api/v1/conversations…). Shown once — store it safely; revoke instantly kills it.
developers.keyRevealed: Copy your API key now — it will not be shown again.
developers.webhooksHelp: We POST subscribed events to your URL, signed with X-MkEngage-Signature (sha256 HMAC of the raw body using the endpoint secret).
developers.secretRevealed: Copy your signing secret now — it will not be shown again.

moderation.title: Moderation
moderation.subtitle: Block abusive visitors and filter unwanted language across every channel.
moderation.profanityHelp: Matched words in visitor messages are masked before they reach agents. Whole-word, case-insensitive.
moderation.termsHelp: One word per line. Stored lowercased; duplicates removed.
moderation.saveError: Could not save the filter. Please try again.
moderation.banHelp: A banned IP or CIDR range is refused a new chat session on your widget. Supports IPv4 and IPv6.
moderation.banError: Could not ban that address — check the IP is valid.
